title: Restore the current tuning when a track's tuner is reset
body:
Follow-up of #131 and #288, recorded while designing their fix (`issues/00131-hot-plug-midi-devices/`).

With #131, `TrackManager` calls `reset()` on a track's `Tuner` (through `TunerProcessor`) when the track's output MIDI device opens after the track was built, i.e. when it is plugged in late or replugged, and when the track's input device gets disconnected. `Tuner.reset()` re-initialises the output instrument's configuration (e.g. MPE Configuration Message, Pitch Bend Sensitivity), but it does not restore the tuning: e.g. `MpeTuner.reset()` goes back to `Tuning.Standard`, and an MTS tuner does not re-send its tuning. So after such a reset the instrument plays in 12-EDO until the next tuning change.

## Expected

After a track's tuner is reset, the output instrument is tuned to the current tuning again, without waiting for the next tuning change. Where that responsibility lives is part of this issue: e.g. `Tuner.reset()` keeps and re-emits the tuning it holds, or the track/`TrackManager` re-applies the current tuning after the reset.
